notes.risk_per_trade: Fraction of account risked between entry and stop. 0.005 = 0.5%.
notes.max_daily_loss: Daily realized loss limit as a fraction of account. Trips kill switch.
notes.max_correlated_positions: Max simultaneous positions within one beta_group (e.g. btc_beta).
notes.fee_bps: Round-trip fee assumption in basis points per side (taker). 10 bps = 0.10%.
notes.max_model_uncertainty: If forecast_volatility_ratio (or normalized uncertainty proxy) exceeds this, block + trip kill switch.
